t: Ink — Notes editor with live preview
A lightweight in-browser notes editor with live preview, insert headings, lists, tasks, and tables, and copy or download the text as a portable file for teams, writers, and researchers.
Notes space with no setup required

Start right away: this lightweight editing space brings notes, specs, and team decisions together in one place and shows a live preview as you type, with no account, server, or connection needed. Enter the page title, choose the text direction, then use the insert buttons to add headings, lists, tasks, tables, and code blocks. Every change appears in the preview instantly, and you can copy the final text or download it as a portable file to reuse in any tool you prefer. Your data isn't sent to anyone, and nothing is saved after you close the page, so keep a copy if you need one. Designed for small teams, writers, and labs that want a quick, organized draft before moving it into their own system.

Do I need an account to use this page?
No. You can write, preview, copy, and download directly, and everything stays on the page as long as you don't close it.
How do I save my work?
Click Download to get a portable text file, or copy the content into any workspace you use. There is no autosave after you close the page.
Does the page support right-to-left text?
Yes, choose the direction from the dropdown, and the editor and preview will switch instantly.
